note: ROOM 5 ACT I: INTERRUPTION AND RESUME. Run by tools/gauntlet/frames.mjs. Ten conversations with Winnie, each begun at a different point of her work cycle (varied gaps), each exited at once; bursts every half second across the opening, the list, the exit and her return to work. Her loop is a pure function of the room clock, so what the bursts must show is: the look-up frame held while her tree is open, and the loop resumed the instant control returns -- never a frozen frame, never a restart.
